description: This file defines the LeaveCommentDecorator class, which adds additional behaviors and utilities to LeaveComment entities in the OrangeHRM Leave Plugin. It provides methods for setting related entities (Employee, User, Leave) and formatting date-time information for leave comments.

classes.name: LeaveCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class adding behavior to the LeaveComment entity, such as setting related entities and formatting timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveComment entity.

methods.name: getLeaveComment
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the decorated LeaveComment entity.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the leave comment based on employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Sets the User who created the leave comment based on user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveById
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with the comment based on leave ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time formatted as H:i.
